name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2026-07-13, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
